body.title: Connect Nowledge Mem for Codex
body.brief:
Set up Nowledge Mem for Codex on this machine so Codex can search and save memories.

1. Install the nmem CLI if it isn't there.
2. Connect it to my space with this connect token: nmem_ct_8fK2pQx7Lm4vRz9TbW3y
3. Install the Mem plugin into Codex and check that a search works.

This is a headless Linux box, no browser. Don't touch my other Codex settings.
